title: Mannish Man Axe of Manliness
description: Mannish Man Axe of Manliness — The Townstons wiki
html:
Mannish Man Axe of Manliness
Client type:  1H Axe
Class palette:  Fighter
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Mannish Man Axe of Manliness is a named mythic item from the client file items/pal/1HAxePAL.gc (MythicPreBuilt003).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

The template sets SoulBound = true. This axe does NOT discriminate its usage based on race, gender, beliefs, or choice of hairstyle. However, it does require that you speak with a husky voice.

Fixed mods on this template (client LabelType = NONE, always on the item):

  • AGI, STR
  • +Slashing
  • Health steal
  • Attack rating
  • Speed
